info.title: ProjGraph CLI
info.description: CLI tool to visualize project dependencies and generate graphs.

commands.name: classdiagram
commands.description: Generate a Mermaid Class Diagram for a C# file

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --inheritance
options.description:
Discover base classes and
interfaces in the workspace
(optional)

options.name: --dependencies
options.description:
Discover dependent types in the
workspace (optional)

options.name: --properties
options.description:
True       Show properties and fields in
the diagram (default true)

options.name: --functions
options.description: True       Show functions and methods in

options.name: --depth
options.description:
1          Max depth for relationship
discovery (default 1)

options.name: --show-title
options.description:
True       Include the diagram title
(default true)

options.name: --output
options.description: The output file path

commands.name: erd
commands.description: Generate a Mermaid ERD for an Entity Framework Core DbContext

options.name: --help
options.description:
Prints help information
ModelSnapshot to analyze
(optional)

options.name: --context
options.description:
The name of the DbContext or
ModelSnapshot to analyze
(optional)

options.name: --show-title
options.description:
True       Include the diagram title
(default true)

options.name: --output
options.description: The output file path

options.name: --owned-mode
options.description:
mirror     How EF Core owned types are
shown: 'mirror' inlines
table-split owned types onto
the owner as EF names them

every owned type its own
entity
